fullPassage: The term "anchoring" was introduced by Roland Barthes who observed that text is often used next to images (his focus was on photographs) to confine meaning. Of all possible literal or implied interpretations an image could elicit, text would point the viewer towards a desired, specific direction. In advertising, as Barthes argues, the symbolic message does not guide identification but interpretation. The viewer is not asked to recognize what they see but to understand why they see it and what it means to them. By combining images with text, advertising produces symbolic meaning that is accurate and specific on the one hand, richer on the other, thus adding depth and eliminating breadth of rational and emotional interpretations. The headline or tagline of an ad directs the reader through the intended meanings of the image, so that it "remote-controls" the reader towards a meaning chosen in advance.

In advertising, as Barthes argues, the symbolic message does not guide identification but interpretation. The viewer is not asked to recognize what they see but to understand why they see it and what it means to them. By combining images with text, advertising produces symbolic meaning that is accurate and specific on the one hand, richer on the other, thus adding depth and eliminating breadth of rational and emotional interpretations. The headline or tagline of an ad directs the reader through the intended meanings of the image, so that it "remote-controls" the reader towards a meaning chosen in advance.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 specific과 의미가 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: 텍스트가 이끄는 방향이 '구체적'이라는 내용에서 반대말을 고르는 문제예요.
det.analysis:
specific은 '구체적인, 특정한'이라는 뜻이에요.

반대말은 general(일반적인, 포괄적인)이라 정답이에요.

exact(정확한), particular(특정한)는 동의어 함정이고, emotional(감정적인)은 의미축이 전혀 달라요.

[선지 판정] ❌① ❌② ✅③ ❌④
det.tip: specific(구체적) ↔ general(일반적). 동의어·무관어를 걸러내세요.

questions.passage:
(A) In an advertisement, a short caption can <u>point</u> the viewer toward one intended meaning.
(B) The most important <u>point</u> of her argument was difficult to summarize in a single line.
questions.stem: 다음 (A), (B)의 밑줄 친 point의 문맥적 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: point가 문맥에 따라 동사(가리키다)와 명사(요점)로 쓰인다는 것을 묻는 문제예요.
det.analysis:
(A)에서는 짧은 문구가 시청자를 하나의 의미 쪽으로 '가리키다, 이끌다'라는 동사예요.

(B)에서는 주장의 가장 중요한 '요점, 핵심'을 뜻하는 명사예요.

③ '뾰족하게 하다 — 점수', ④ '지적하다 — 시점'은 두 문맥과 맞지 않아요.

[선지 판정] ✅① ❌② ❌③ ❌④
det.tip: 같은 철자라도 문맥(동사/명사)에 따라 뜻이 달라져요.

questions.stem:
다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은?

"the distance or measurement from one side to the other; the wide extent of something"

det.korean: 한쪽에서 다른 쪽까지의 '폭', 넓은 범위를 뜻하는 단어를 고르는 문제예요.
det.analysis:
정의는 '넓은 범위, 폭(wide extent)'을 설명해요.

따라서 breadth(폭, 너비)가 정답이에요.

depth(깊이), length(길이), width(너비)는 정의의 '넓은 범위·폭'이라는 핵심과 정확히 맞지 않아요. (breadth는 특히 '해석의 폭'처럼 추상적 넓이를 뜻해요.)

[선지 판정] ❌① ❌② ❌③ ✅④
det.tip: breadth = 폭, 넓은 범위 (본문의 breadth of interpretations = 해석의 폭).

questions.passage: The term "anchoring" was __________ (introduce) by Roland Barthes, who observed that text is often used next to images to confine meaning.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (영어로) 쓰시오. (1단어)

det.korean: 'anchoring'이라는 용어가 Barthes에 의해 '도입되었다'는 내용이에요.
det.analysis:
빈칸은 'was + __________ (be동사 뒤)' 자리예요.

주어(the term)가 도입되는 대상이고 by가 뒤따르므로 수동태예요. 동사 introduce(도입하다)를 과거분사 introduced로 바꿔야 해요.

따라서 정답은 introduced예요.
det.tip: was + 과거분사 + by ~ = ~에 의해 …되었다 (수동태).

questions.passage: By __________ (combine) images with text, advertising produces symbolic meaning that is accurate and specific on the one hand, richer on the other.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (영어로) 쓰시오. (1단어)

det.korean: 이미지와 텍스트를 '결합함으로써' 광고가 상징적 의미를 만든다는 내용이에요.
det.analysis:
빈칸은 전치사 By 바로 뒤 자리예요.

전치사 뒤에는 동사가 그대로 올 수 없고 동명사(-ing)가 와야 해요. 동사 combine(결합하다)을 combining으로 바꿔요.

따라서 정답은 combining이에요.
det.tip: By + 동명사(V-ing) = ~함으로써.

questions.passage: The term "anchoring" was introduced by Roland Barthes who observed that text is often used next to images (his focus was on photographs) to confine meaning. Of all possible literal or implied interpretations an image could elicit, text would point the viewer towards a desired, specific direction. In advertising, as Barthes argues, the __________ does not guide identification but interpretation. The viewer is not asked to recognize what they see but to understand why they see it and what it means to them. By combining images with text, advertising produces symbolic meaning that is accurate and specific on the one hand, richer on the other, thus adding depth and eliminating breadth of rational and emotional interpretations. The headline or tagline of an ad directs the reader through the intended meanings of the image, so that it "remote-controls" the reader towards a meaning chosen in advance.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 광고에서 '상징적 메시지'가 무엇을 이끄는지 설명하는 부분이에요.
det.analysis:
빈칸 뒤에서 그것이 '인식이 아니라 해석을 이끈다'고 하고, 뒤 문장에서도 '상징적 의미'가 반복돼요.

따라서 symbolic message(상징적 메시지)가 정답이에요.

visual image(시각적 이미지), literal meaning(문자적 의미), factual report(사실 보도)는 글의 핵심 표현이 아니에요.

[선지 판정] ❌① ✅② ❌③ ❌④
det.tip: 뒤 문장의 'symbolic meaning'과 이어지는 핵심어를 찾으세요.

questions.passage: The term "anchoring" was introduced by Roland Barthes who observed that text is often used next to images (his focus was on photographs) to confine meaning. Of all possible literal or implied interpretations an image could elicit, text would point the viewer towards a desired, specific direction. In advertising, as Barthes argues, the symbolic message does not guide identification but interpretation. The viewer is not asked to recognize what they see but to understand why they see it and what it means to them. By combining images with text, advertising produces symbolic meaning that is accurate and specific on the one hand, richer on the other, thus adding depth and eliminating breadth of rational and emotional interpretations. The headline or tagline of an ad directs the reader through the intended meanings of the image, so that it "remote-controls" the reader towards a meaning __________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 헤드라인이 독자를 '미리 정해진' 의미로 이끈다는 결론부 내용이에요.
det.analysis:
빈칸은 헤드라인이 독자를 이끄는 의미의 성격이에요.

텍스트가 이미지의 '의도된 의미'로 유도해 '원격 조종'한다고 했으니, 그 의미는 '미리 선택된' 것이에요. 따라서 chosen in advance(미리 선택된)가 정답이에요.

left to chance(우연에 맡겨진), hidden from view(시야에서 감춰진), changed over time(시간에 따라 바뀌는)은 '미리 정해진'이라는 흐름과 반대이거나 무관해요.

[선지 판정] ❌① ❌② ✅③ ❌④
det.tip: 'remote-controls ~ towards a meaning ___'이 '미리 정해 둔 의미'로 이끈다는 뜻임을 파악하세요.
